thread:
nora-cs: Urgent: pilot customer OrbitPay seeing 429s on SDK boot in their Android WebView pool. Demo tomorrow, they're blocked. Can we triage quickly?

jenny-support: Support logs show bursts of `preflight_init` 429s and repeated `token_refresh` 429s tied to org=orbitpay. They said multiple WebViews are reused by a pool process and init runs on each attach.

deepa-eng: That pooling + attach behaviour will create parallel preflights. Short-term server-side options: coalesce identical preflight requests for that org, bump short-window burst, and temporarily lengthen ephemeral token TTL to reduce refresh storms.

liam-sre: I see a 60s slice with ~780 preflight rpm. I can enable coalescing and raise their short-window cap +300 for 5h if CS approves. I'll also monitor.

nora-cs: OrbitPay okayed a temporary change via DM. Please proceed. They can't ship an SDK fix before the demo.

deepa-eng: For a durable client fix (post-demo) we recommend a cross-WebView locking approach using IndexedDB as a mutex (works across contexts even when BroadcastChannel is unavailable in some WebViews). Sample pattern: acquire an IndexedDB lock before preflight; use a singleton init promise in-page; release lock after success; add jittered backoff on 429s. That avoids multi-process fanout. We'll draft a small patch for the JS SDK showing the IndexedDB mutex pattern.

liam-sre: Applied: coalescing=ON for org=orbitpay, burst +300 (expires 5h), ephemeral token TTL +28s. infra-bot: action success. redwood-ratebot will alert if we still see errors.

redwood-ratebot: alert: orbitpay preflight spike (780 rpm) -> coalesce enabled, burst cap increased, TTL extended. Monitoring 20m.

jenny-support: Setting up a 20m pre-demo call and will capture logs. Post-demo followups: 1) ship SDK patch with IndexedDB mutex + capped concurrent preflights; 2) doc: "Embedding SDKs in pooled WebView environments"; 3) gateway support for opt-in header `x-session-debounce` to collapse duplicates from the same logical session.

nora-cs: Thanks team — I'll join the pre-demo call and update OrbitPay. Good work.
